$comment: Policy for rule-based IaC scanning with `trivy config` (Trivy: Apache-2.0; checks: MIT). Runs offline with the checks embedded in the Trivy binary. Exclusions/groupings were tuned on TerraGoat, Kubernetes Goat, terraform-aws-vpc, terraform-aws-eks and grafana/helm-charts.

excludeChecks.KSV-0118: 'Default security context configured' fires on nearly every workload (26 on Kubernetes Goat, 9 on the Grafana chart); the concrete checks (privileged, host namespaces, hostPath, root) cover the real risk.
excludeChecks.KSV-0014: Read-only root filesystem is a hardening best practice, not a vulnerability; very common in production charts.
excludeChecks.AWS-0104: Unrestricted security-group EGRESS is the AWS default and almost always intended (5 hits on terraform-aws-eks). Unrestricted INGRESS stays enabled.
excludeChecks.AWS-0132: Customer-managed KMS keys for S3 are a cost/compliance choice; unencrypted buckets are still reported by AWS-0088.

groups.title: S3 bucket public access is not fully blocked
groups.resolution: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block for the bucket with block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls and restrict_public_buckets all set to true (or enable account-level S3 Block Public Access).
